mapper.insert: INSERT INTO property_building(id, landlord_id, name, address, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{landlordId}, #{name}, #{address}, 'ACTIVE', #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_building WHERE id = #{id} AND landlord_id = #{landlordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO property_unit(id, building_id, landlord_id, unit_no, title, room_count, hall_count, bathroom_count, area_sqm, occupancy_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{buildingId}, #{landlordId}, #{unitNo}, #{title}, #{rooms}, #{halls}, #{bathrooms}, #{areaSqm}, 'VACANT', #{now}, #{now})
